definitions.explanation: The outermost part or boundary of something.

examples.japanese: テーブルの{端|はし}に{座|すわ}ってください。
examples.english: Please sit at the end of the table.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}の{端|はし}に{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write your name at the edge of the paper.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}の{端|はし}を{歩|ある}いてください。
examples.english: Please walk on the edge of the road.

notes: {端|はし} refers to the outermost edge or end of something. Don't confuse this with {橋|はし} (bridge) or {箸|はし} (chopsticks) - all three are pronounced 'hashi' but have different kanji and pitch accents. [noun]の{端|はし} means 'the edge/end of [noun].'
